newsitem.title: CANADA: Teck, Newmont lobby on Bre-X.
newsitem.headline: Teck, Newmont lobby on Bre-X.

text.p: Teck Corp and Newmont Mining Corp are discussing a joint bid for Bre-X Minerals Ltd's Busang gold discovery and Teck president Norman Keevil is in Indonesia to lobby for an open auction, Teck said Wednesday.

Teck senior vice president Mike Lipkewich said Teck's hopes were growing. "There is a sense the whole thing will be opened up...but it is still not a certainty," he said in an interview. Teck is working with Newmont as a potential joint venture partner and Newmont also thinks the Indonesian government may allow an auction to be held, he said.
"We are very interested in the property," Lipkewich said. "We have had numerous discussions with Bre-X. We were looking at it very seriously. "
"Our discussions have been with ourselves and Newmont Mining as a joint venture partner," he said.

The Indonesian government had directed Bre-X to form a joint venture with Barrick Gold Corp. But the process has dragged on and Placer Dome Inc, in the hope of persuading Jakarta to allow competing offers, recently announced a US$5 billion proposal to merge with Bre-X.

Placer chief executive officer John Willson has also gone to Jakarta to press his case and senior Barrick officials are there too. Denver-based Newmont, which has operations in Indonesia, also has top executives there, Lipkewich said.
Lipkewich declined to discuss the details of Keevil's activities in Jakarta but said there were no developments to report. He said Keevil may only be there for another day or so.
